title: The Pink Cat Halloween Costume
intro: The cat costume, done warm enough for actual trick or treating. A pink puff sleeve sweater dress with thigh high socks and glitter ears, and the dress keeps working long after the candy is gone.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on pale wood of a pink sweater dress, pink glitter cat ears, white thigh high socks, white bow flats, gold heart earrings, a pink heart bag and pink pail.
Woman walking down farmhouse porch steps at dusk in a pink sweater dress, pink cat ears, white thigh high socks and bow flats, carrying a pink heart bag and tumbler.
